description: A reader who has come back after a break asks what to work on; two solid items have gone rusty. The tutor says so plainly, once, and offers to move them back to Frontier and practise, naming only items the request listed.

request.greek: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν
request.english: And we know that all things work together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
request.question: What should I work on today?
